title: Marvin is now fully integrated as the unified drawing experience across Certara’s Discovery portfolio
summary: Marvin, Certara's chemical sketching tool, is now integrated across Design Hub, Compound Registration, Compliance Checker, and D360 — one editor, every workflow.
body_markdown:
ShareShareShare


[Marvin](https://www.certara.com/marvin/) , Certara’s chemical sketching tool, is now integrated as the unified drawing experience across its Discovery portfolio. This integration into each product’s workflow eliminates inconsistent sketching tools, saving time and avoiding unnecessary training as user move between platforms for design (Design Hub), registration (Compound Registration), compound compliance (Compliance Checker), and analysis (D360).


Now fully web-based, Marvin brings its complete feature set to every product. This includes:


- A clean interface with a[universal search bar](https://www.certara.com/video/how-to-marvin-search-bar/)
- Familiar[keyboard shortcuts](https://www.certara.com/video/how-to-marvin-keyboard-shortcuts/)
- Instant[name-to-structure conversion](https://www.certara.com/video/how-to-marvin-name-to-structure-conversion/) , backed by Chemaxon’s chemical intelligence for catching errors as users draw
- [Live calculations](https://www.certara.com/video/how-to-marvin-calculate-physico-chemical-properties/) and MDL-compatible stereochemistry handling with CIP descriptors.


Marvin is built for enterprise-scale deployment; organizations can extend the same experience beyond the Discovery portfolio into their ELN, internal applications, and[Microsoft Office documents](https://www.certara.com/video/how-to-marvin-microsoft-office-integration/) via JChem for Office.
